settings.title: Grow lights for kitchen herbs.
settings.content: Kitchen herbs need a setup that fits counters, windowsills, and everyday cooking routines.

settings.title: The kitchen herb problem
settings.content: Kitchen spots are often small, busy, and inconsistent in natural light.

settings.title: Recommended setup
settings.content: Use a compact herb kit or small grow light setup that stays easy to clean and easy to reach.

settings.title: Soliseed herb garden kit
settings.content: A beginner-friendly setup for kitchen herbs and small indoor growing spots.

settings.title: Setup tips
settings.content: Keep the setup away from heavy splashes, leave room for harvesting, and check timer settings after moving pots.

settings.title: Is a window enough for kitchen herbs?
settings.content: Some windows help, but a grow light can support herbs when window light is limited or inconsistent.

settings.title: Keep herbs close to where you use them.
settings.content: A good kitchen setup should be compact, reachable, and simple to maintain.
